title: Players refer to standard areas
body:
Fixes #2334 

* [x] For `StandardAreaMenu` move `select` control to the top-left, but place it vertically beneath the `cancel planning` button. Note: if we use `position:topLeft` they get stacked on each other
* [x] In `OrderDrawing`, if player selects item from menu, cancel planning polygon
* [x] In `OrderDrawing`  generate planning activity using selected polygon
* [x] In `OrderDrawing` it looks like `GeoMan` is intercepting the `StandardAreaMenu` click, and treating it as the start of the polygon
* [x] Aaah, err, in the current implementation we get a new control each time we create new orders. I'm sure it should be deleted 
* [x] Also try to allow use of `Standard Areas` in `OrderEditing`, too
* [x] Swap the `Standard Area Menu` popup to use some other icon. Shapes? The letters `S/A`?

comments_data.body:
Hello @philb89  - thanks for helping move this forward.

I now realise that I don't think we can use `standard` areas in `Order Editing`.  When a player is creating a new set of orders `OrderDrawing` - we know the steps when a polygon could be used, and we can offer the list of standard areas at those steps.  But, with `Order Editing`, the player is looking at the full set of shapes for that set of orders, and we don't know which shape should be swapped for the standard area.

Hmmm, if there is only one polygon for the set of shapes, then we can swap that polygon for the standard area.  

Aah, ok.  We only show the `Standard Areas` menu in `Order Editing` if there is just one polygon in the set of shapes. I can implement that :-)

One last bit:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/218303580-24db5fb2-db32-4d75-8d70-6e1ae720c67f.png)

We're not quite moving the logic forward properly.   I'm in this story:
https://serge-phileba-2334-stan-raxggo.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-organisms-planningchannel--with-areas

I select a blue icon form the map, so it's selected, and flashing. Then I click the button to start the process of creating a new set of orders. I select "Land" and "Patrol".  I asks me to enter the line. I enter the line. Then it wants a polygon, so I select one of the standard areas.  Then - it should ask me to enter the line for the "Route back".  If you add a polygon (instead of selecting the existing area) - then you will see this happen.   But, in the current logic, things _stop_ when I select an existing area.

BTW - fixing the above (moving edit process forward) is more important than `OrderEditing` right now.  In tomorrow's rehearsal I'd like players to start creating orders using standard areas - but we need the process to work for that to happen  :-)

issues.title: Players refer to standard areas
issues.body:
As a player I wish to **Select a polygon from an existing list** in order to **refer to standard areas**

As players are doing high level planning of the next turn, they start referring to standard areas.

Some areas may be on land, and some on sea.  The whole current map may be split into, say 10 polygons.

While generating their orders, players may wish to select an existing polygon instead of drawing one.

So, we will introduce a `areas` array in the `WargameData` object.  Like the other elements in the `WargameData` object this will have a parent `wrapper` element called `areas` that contains an array of `ArrayData` elements.  These array elements will have these parameters:
```
  // user label for this shape
  name: string
  // which forces use this shape
  usedBy: Array<ForceData['uniqid']>
  // the shape itself (probably a Polygon, but could be line or point)
  feature: GeoJSON.Polygon
``` 

This will be supported in the `OrderDrawing` and `OrderEditing` pages.

The will receive a new prop called `areas: AreaData[]`.  This will have already been filtered by the parent class for this force.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/217224141-dff9db1d-9ba8-4df9-aba1-56d751a4a6e6.png)

If the next shape to be drawn is a polygon, then a new drop-down list will appear next to the `Cancel editing` button.  This will contain a list of areas for this force. Selecting one will add that polygon to the set of shapes, and move onto the next one.

Hi @IanMayo, I have some questions:
- In OrderDrawing generate planning activity using selected polygon: do you mean we generate a planning activity on planning polygon (not a "completed" polygon)?
- Aaah, err, in the current implementation we get a new control each time we create new orders. I'm sure it should be deleted: Can you explain more detail?

1.  Currently - when the player finishes the polygon, the `useState` handler for `pendingGeometry` looks at the new shape, and creates a new `res` item, and adds it to the list.  But, if a player clicks one of these existing areas, we should make that `useState` handler create the new geometry from the existing one (provided in the useStandardArea click-handler)
2. If we cancel drawing the polygon, the standard-area-menu is still shown. We should remove it on `Cancel` or after a standard area is selected. Video below.

Video: https://i.gyazo.com/afd46cca68e2ad62448ae61dc1083fc2.mp4
